b092.name: the 5-HTP stop signs, fifth try: Codex's rewrite with its panel's agreed points fixed
b092.text: If the 5-HTP gives you nausea or stomach discomfort, stop the trial. Same with loose stools or a headache. Stop immediately if you get agitation together with sweating, diarrhea, tremor or clonus, and fever, confusion, a fast heart rate or unstable blood pressure, since that pattern can be serotonin toxicity, which can become dangerous. Feeling anxious, irritable or agitated, sweating, tremor, or a too-bright, kind of hypomanic feeling are milder stop signs, and so are insomnia and dreams that get vivid or intense.
b092.why: a writer of another family after four of mine read AI (E253: Codex, tell_panel.py rewrite-prompt, rewrite-b092/), then the panel on its draft: the repeated "reasons to stop" frames varied and joined, the near-synonyms joined ("Feeling anxious, irritable or agitated"), the hedge sentence joined to the stop line; the label gone, as his Y-90 and Y-91 dropped theirs
